notes: Gasoline fleet. Play is probe → finding → call the fix. Only core items are required.

cases.title: Dead after the trailer
cases.hint: Cheap stuff first. Gas and the kill switch. Don't start with the engine.

cart.notes: Older Club Car utility. Just came off an enclosed Trailer Transit load.

cases.ticket: Unloaded this morning off the enclosed trailer. Key is on. Pedal goes down and the engine never turns over. Fuel gauge is sitting on empty.
cases.cause: Tank is empty and the kill switch was left off after unload. Fill it, switch on, it fires.
cases.still: Pedal down, the engine still doesn't turn over.

checks.label: Check the gas
checks.finding: Gauge is on empty. Tank is dry.
checks.after: That's only part of the issue.

checks.label: Check the kill switch
checks.finding: Kill switch is off.
checks.after: That's only part of the issue.

checks.label: Put gas in it
checks.finding: Tank's full now.
checks.after: Pedal down — engine still doesn't turn over.

checks.label: Fill it and turn the kill switch on
checks.finding: Gas in it, kill switch on. It starts and idles.

forbidden.label: That's an engine swap for a dry tank.

cases.title: Cranks, never fires
cases.hint: It cranks and it smells like gas. Next question is spark.

cart.notes: Common 4-passenger Club Car.

cases.setting: Charlotte shop. Came back from last weekend.
cases.ticket: Engine cranks but never starts. You can smell raw gas around the carb. Operator has been trying to start it over and over.
cases.cause: Fouled spark plug. They flooded it. New plug, stop cranking.
cases.still: It still cranks and never fires.

checks.label: Pull the spark plug
checks.finding: Plug is wet and black. Fouled.
checks.after: That's the problem. Now change it.

checks.label: Check for spark
checks.finding: Weak spark on a dirty plug. Plug is the problem, not the coil.

checks.label: Put a new plug in
checks.finding: New plug in. It fires on the first try.

forbidden.label: The engine is spinning. It's a plug.

cases.title: Starts, then dies
cases.hint: It's starving after it starts. Look at the filter. The gas in these rental carts does not sit long enough to go bad.

cart.notes: Rental 4PF. Gas turns over every event — it does not sit long enough to go stale.

cases.ticket: Starts on the first try, runs about ten seconds, then dies. Restarts every time. Same cycle if you keep doing it.
cases.cause: Clogged fuel filter. These carts drink fuel all week. The filter packed up, not the gas.
cases.still: It still starts, runs about ten seconds, then dies.

checks.label: Check the fuel filter
checks.finding: Filter is packed and barely passing fuel.

checks.label: Replace the fuel filter
checks.finding: New filter on. It holds a long idle and a test loop.

forbidden.label: Don't throw a carb before the filter.

cases.title: Oil all over the side
cases.hint: Find the leak, but check the stick first so you don't run it dry.

cart.notes: Real writeup: oil leak side gasket.

cases.setting: After TSS. Sitting in the out-of-service row.
cases.ticket: Oil on the left side of the engine and a drip under the cart on the trailer. They drove it in anyway.
cases.cause: Side case gasket. Check oil, replace the gasket, refill. Don't send it leaking.
cases.still: It's still leaking.

checks.label: Check the oil
checks.finding: Oil is down. Not empty yet.

checks.label: Find the leak
checks.finding: It's weeping from the side case gasket, not the drain plug.

checks.label: Replace the gasket and refill
checks.finding: Gasket replaced, oil refilled. No drip on the next start.

forbidden.label: Don't send a leaker to the next event.

cases.title: It sounds like rocks in a can
cases.hint: Knocking motor. Oil, then shut it down. Don't keep driving it.

cart.notes: Kansas drop-off: internal engine noise.

cases.setting: Kansas. They dropped it at the track.
cases.ticket: Cart runs, but there's a knock from inside the engine. It got louder crossing the lot.
cases.cause: Internal knock. Check oil, shut it off, tag it out. Not a carb job.
cases.still: The knock is still there.

checks.label: Check the oil
checks.finding: Oil is on the stick. This isn't a dry motor. The knock is still there.

checks.label: Shut it down and tag it out
checks.finding: You kill it and tag it out of service. Right call. This one doesn't go back in the row.

forbidden.label: A knock is not a carb.

cases.title: Valor dies after it gets hot
cases.hint: EX1 heat-soaks. Look at the driver's-side screen and the cooling fins.

cart.notes: NP / TV compound. Drive-on only.

cases.setting: Iowa infield. Suite shuttles in the sun.
cases.ticket: Runs about 20 minutes, then loses power and dies. Restarts after it sits. Driver-side rear of the engine is packed with dirt.
cases.cause: Clogged CVT cooling screen and dirty fins. Clean them. Not a new engine.
cases.still: After it gets hot it still dies.

checks.label: Check the CVT / cooling screen
checks.finding: Driver-side CVT screen is packed solid with dirt.

checks.label: Check the cooling fins
checks.finding: Fins are caked. No air getting through.

checks.label: Clean the fins and screen
checks.finding: Screen and fins are clear. After a hot test loop it holds power.

forbidden.label: Don't replace an EX1 because it's dirty.

cases.title: Valor won't crank
cases.hint: This is an ISG cart. Check 12V first, then the ISG — not a car starter.

cart.notes: ISG, not a regular starter.

cases.ticket: Key on, lights work, engine will not crank. They jumped it off another cart and it still will not crank.
cases.cause: ISG controller. Battery was fine. Updated controller, not a starter motor.
cases.still: Lights work. It still will not crank.

checks.label: Check the 12V battery
checks.finding: Battery is 12.6V. Cables are clean. Jumping it did nothing because the battery isn't the problem.

checks.label: ISG controller
checks.finding: ISG controller is dead. New updated unit in, it cranks.

forbidden.label: Valor doesn't take a regular starter.

cases.title: Engine screams, cart crawls
cases.hint: Motor is making power. The belt isn't taking it to the axle.

cart.notes: Heavy 6-pass. Suite hill.

cases.ticket: Fine around the compound. Halfway up the suite hill the engine revs and the cart barely moves. You can smell belt.
cases.cause: Glazed drive belt. Replace the belt. Engine is fine.
cases.still: Engine still revs and the cart barely moves.

checks.label: Look at the drive belt
checks.finding: Belt is glazed and shiny. That's the smell.

checks.label: Check the clutches
checks.finding: Clutches look serviceable. Belt is the worn part.

checks.label: Put a new belt on
checks.finding: New belt on. It pulls the hill without screaming.

forbidden.label: The engine is revving. That's not a dead motor.

cases.title: Pulls left after offload
cases.hint: Engine is fine. Get under the front and look.

cart.notes: Off a Sun Valley at Richmond.

cases.ticket: Pulls hard left as soon as you start rolling. Engine sounds fine. They only drove it off the trailer about 40 feet.
cases.cause: Bent tie rod from the strap or unload. Mechanical.
cases.still: It still pulls hard left.

checks.label: Inspect the steering
checks.finding: Left tie rod is bent. Looks like a strap or a hit on the way off.

checks.label: Replace the tie rod
checks.finding: New tie rod on. It tracks straight.

forbidden.label: Don't tear into the engine for a pull.

cases.title: It shut off and the light's on
cases.hint: Believe the oil light. Don't jump it.

cart.notes: Shop utility.

cases.ticket: Died in the alley. Low oil / fuel light is on. Operator wants it jumped so they can keep using it.
cases.cause: Low oil. These engines shut down on purpose. Fill it, find the leak.
cases.still: The light is still on. It still won't stay running.

checks.label: Check the oil
checks.finding: Stick is almost dry. That's why it died.

checks.label: Find the leak
checks.finding: Slow weep at the side gasket. That's where the oil went.

checks.label: Add oil and park it until the leak is fixed
checks.finding: Oil filled. You keep it out of the row until the gasket is done.

forbidden.label: Don't jump a low-oil shutdown.

cases.title: No power after a dusty day
cases.hint: It runs. It just can't breathe. Pull the air filter.

cart.notes: Infield utility. Dusty all afternoon.

cases.ticket: Runs, but it has no power. They have to floor it to get across the lot. Air box looks filthy.
cases.cause: Packed air filter. Clean or replace it. Engine is fine.
cases.still: It still runs with no power.

checks.label: Check the air filter
checks.finding: Air filter is packed solid with infield dirt.

checks.label: Clean or replace the air filter
checks.finding: Filter cleaned. It pulls clean and has power again.

forbidden.label: Don't throw an engine at a dirty filter.

cases.title: Fine yesterday, dead this morning
cases.hint: 12V died overnight. Look at the starter generator belt before you buy a battery.

cart.notes: Ran all day yesterday. Parked in the row overnight.

cases.ticket: Ran all day. This morning it clicks and won't crank. They want a new battery.
cases.cause: Starter generator belt came off. Battery went dead overnight because nothing was charging. Belt back on, then charge the 12V.
cases.still: It still won't crank.

checks.label: Check the 12V battery
checks.finding: Battery is dead. That's why it won't crank. Now ask why it died overnight.
checks.after: That's only part of the issue.

checks.label: Check the starter generator belt
checks.finding: Starter generator belt is off the pulley. That's why it never charged.

checks.label: Put the belt back on and charge the battery
checks.finding: Belt on, battery charged. It cranks.

forbidden.label: A new battery will die again if the belt is still off.

cases.title: Starts, then starves after unload
cases.hint: Filter can be fine. Follow the fuel line. Trailer straps pinch them.

cart.notes: Just came off a Sun Valley.

cases.ticket: Started on the trailer ramp. Thirty feet later it dies. Restarts, dies again. Fuel filter looks new.
cases.cause: Fuel line kinked under a strap from the haul. Straighten or replace the line. Gas is fine. Filter is fine.
cases.still: It still dies after it rolls a little.

checks.label: Follow the fuel line
checks.finding: Line is kinked where the strap sat. Filter is clean.

checks.label: Straighten or replace the line
checks.finding: Line free. It runs across the lot without dying.

forbidden.label: The filter is already new.

cases.title: Howls on the suite hill
cases.hint: That's not the engine. Check rear end oil.

cart.notes: Heavy 6-pass. Suite runs all weekend.

cases.ticket: Engine sounds fine. Halfway up the hill the rear end howls. They think it's a belt.
cases.cause: Rear end is low on oil. Fill it. Don't keep pulling the hill dry.
cases.still: The rear end still howls under load.

checks.label: Check rear end oil
checks.finding: Rear end is almost dry. That's the howl.

checks.label: Fill the rear end
checks.finding: Rear end filled. The howl is gone on the next pull.

forbidden.label: A howl from the axle is not a belt.

cases.title: It crawls and smells hot
cases.hint: Engine is fine. Look at the park brake before you pull the belt.

cart.notes: Customer just brought it back to the compound.

cases.ticket: Barely moves. Engine revs. They smell something hot. They want a belt.
cases.cause: Park brake is still on. Release it. Rear brakes are hot.
cases.still: It still crawls and smells hot.

checks.label: Check the park brake
checks.finding: Park brake is still set. Rears are too hot to hold.

checks.label: Release the park brake and let it cool
checks.finding: Brake off. After it cools it rolls normal.

forbidden.label: Don't throw a belt at a parked brake.

cases.title: Cranks, no fire, after the trailer
cases.hint: It ran when it went on the trailer. Check the plug wire before you buy a plug.

cart.notes: Just off an enclosed load.

cases.ticket: Ran when they loaded it. Now it cranks and never fires. No gas smell.
cases.cause: Spark plug wire pulled off in transit. Push it back on.
cases.still: It still cranks and never fires.

checks.label: Check the plug wire
checks.finding: Plug wire is sitting next to the plug, not on it.

checks.label: Put the wire back on
checks.finding: Wire seated. It fires first try.

forbidden.label: The plug is fine. The wire is off.

cases.title: Loud and it smells like exhaust
cases.hint: That's not a bottom-end knock. Look at the exhaust flange.

cart.notes: Same family as the Darlington oil-leak cart.

cases.setting: Compound. They parked it because it's loud.
cases.ticket: Runs fine. Sounds like a gun. Exhaust smell in the seat. They think the motor is coming apart.
cases.cause: Exhaust leak at the flange. Gasket or loose nuts. Not an internal knock.
cases.still: It's still loud and it still smells like exhaust.

checks.label: Check the exhaust
checks.finding: Leak at the exhaust flange. Nuts are loose. Motor is not knocking.

checks.label: Tighten or replace the exhaust gasket
checks.finding: Flange sealed. It's quiet again.

forbidden.label: Don't tear the motor down for an exhaust leak.

cases.title: Works, then it won't crank, then it works
cases.hint: Wiggle the 12V cables. Vibration after a weekend will walk a nut off.

cart.notes: Been on the lot all week.

cases.setting: Live event. Radio call from the suite road.
cases.ticket: It was fine. Then it wouldn't crank. They hit a bump and it started. Now it's dead again.
cases.cause: Loose 12V cable. Tighten and clean it. Not an ISG, not a new battery.
cases.still: Sometimes it cranks, sometimes it doesn't.

checks.label: Wiggle the battery cables
checks.finding: Positive cable nut is finger-loose. Green on the ring.

checks.label: Clean and tighten the cable
checks.finding: Cable tight and clean. It cranks every time.

forbidden.label: Don't throw a battery at a loose nut.

cases.title: Valor is lean and lazy
cases.hint: EX1 injector screen packs up with dirt. Not stale gas. These tanks turn over every event.

cart.notes: NP cart. Dusty TV compound.

cases.setting: Iowa. After two days of infield dust.
cases.ticket: Starts. Runs lean and lazy. No real power. They already cleaned the CVT screen.
cases.cause: Dirty injector / inlet screen. Clean or replace the injector. Fuel in the tank is fine.
cases.still: It still starts and has no power.

checks.label: Check the injector
checks.finding: Injector inlet screen is packed with dirt. Tank fuel is fine.

checks.label: Clean or replace the injector
checks.finding: Injector cleaned. It pulls like it should.

forbidden.label: Rental gas does not sit long enough to go bad.

cases.title: No reverse in the trailer alley
cases.hint: Forward is fine. Look at the FNR / reverse cable, not the motor.

cart.notes: Work cart. They use reverse all day packing a Sun Valley.

cases.ticket: Forward is fine. No reverse. They need it to get off the bottom deck.
cases.cause: Reverse side of the FNR / shifter cable. Adjust or replace the FNR. Engine is fine.
cases.still: Forward works. Still no reverse.

checks.label: Check the FNR / reverse cable
checks.finding: FNR is not making reverse. Forward side is fine. Cable is sloppy.

checks.label: Adjust or replace the FNR
checks.finding: FNR adjusted. Reverse works under the trailer.

forbidden.label: The motor pulls fine in forward.
